intro: Every photo below is a GARP Construction Group project in South Florida — our crews, our permits, our punch list. We work on both residential and commercial property, and on most of these jobs more than one of our licenses was in play: a re-roof that also took new impact windows, a build-out that needed the mechanical and the plumbing sequenced against the same schedule. That is the work we are set up for, and it is the reason the scope gets written down before anyone starts.
